purpose: research-only source candidates for Arctus recovery; none are admitted to training by this file

candidates.notes: Hugging Face describes this corpus as curated high-quality educational/synthetic data designed for small language models. The Python-Edu subset is educational code filtered from Stack v2 and its dataset card explicitly directs users to The Stack v2 for the underlying data license, so repository-level ODC-BY metadata is not enough to admit Python-Edu into Neral. Cosmopedia is synthetic. FineWeb-Edu-dedup overlaps conceptually with an already admitted source. Do not admit any subset until exact revision, subset-specific license/provenance, dedupe, benchmark-separation and sample-quality checks are pinned.

Current Hugging Face metadata marks The Stack v2 deduplicated release as gated with repository license 'other'. The dataset spans code with underlying source-level licensing concerns, so it is not admitted to Neral. Existing code capability should be preserved through replay of already admitted data until a dedicated provenance/license pipeline can enforce per-source policy.

Already source-locked in Neral at a pinned revision. The recovery curriculum may vary only its share; it must not silently advance the revision. Hugging Face describes FineMath as mathematical educational web content with emphasis on explanations and step-by-step problem solving. It remains the only currently admitted source explicitly specialized for mathematics.

Hugging Face describes FineWeb2 as a reproducible multilingual pretraining dataset covering more than 1000 languages. Neral already source-locks the deu_Latn configuration at a pinned revision. Weakness pilots may increase the German share without changing that revision.

Hugging Face reports FineWeb-Edu as a 1.3T-token educational English corpus filtered from FineWeb. Neral already source-locks a pinned sample-10BT revision; recovery work may change proportions only through an explicit curriculum experiment, never by silently changing the source revision.

Hugging Face describes FineWeb as cleaned and deduplicated English CommonCrawl data. Neral already source-locks a pinned sample-10BT revision. Keep it as general-language replay rather than increasing narrow specialist data until no-regression pilots justify a change.

Hugging Face metadata describes OASST1 as human-generated and human-annotated, with 161,443 messages in 35 languages including English and German and 461,292 quality ratings. This remains the strongest currently audited candidate for a separate Helios SFT/post-training phase, but it stays excluded from foundation recovery until an exact revision, tree-to-dialogue formatting contract, contamination audit, EOS policy and regression gate are pinned.
